notes.title: Lovely Planet 2 E3 2019 Reveal is here
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/eE34lqD.gif

Back in 2014, tinyBuild and QUICKTEQUILA launched Lovely Planet -- the most adorable First Person Shooter Gun Ballet. Five years after its release, we're super excited to announce the sequel.

Lovely Planet 2: April Skies is coming to Steam on June 18th!

Watch the trailer and add it to your Wishlist!
